About INPACK FABRICATIONS

Engineering Excellence in Packaging Machines Since 2004

Based in IDA Cherlapalli, Hyderabad, INPACK FABRICATIONS PVT. LTD. (IFPL) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer specializing in automatic form, fill, and seal machinery.

Guided by our slogan "commitment to excellence", we manufacture precision machinery tailored for powders, granules, seeds, and snacks. Every machine is engineered for high operational uptime, low maintenance, and exact fill weight consistency.

Superior Quality

Heavy-duty food-grade SS304/316 metallurgy

Pinpoint Accuracy

Microprocessor load cell and servo dosing

Dedicated Service

Prompt nationwide field service & spare parts support

Competitive Price

Direct OEM manufacturer pricing advantages
